meta.howProduced: Player.ts imported unmodified, bundled with esbuild, run under node against a 288x224 CellGrid window filled by the TypeScript worldgen at seed 2334 and then stamped with the arena in `edits`. Frozen artefact of the original implementation: never regenerate it from the Rust side. Floats are IEEE754 double bit patterns, never decimals. TypeScript computed every one of them in f64.

cases.name: run-and-stop
cases.why: acceleration to the cap, ground friction to a dead stop, and the same again reversed

cases.name: jump-full
cases.why: a whole arc with the button held: no cut, apex deadband, landing, land timer

cases.name: jump-cut
cases.why: released after 9 steps: JUMP_CUT applies exactly once, on the step the hold drops

cases.name: coyote
cases.why: walk off the ledge at cell 171 and jump 6 steps later, well inside COYOTE_TIME

cases.name: coyote-expired
cases.why: the same walk-off, jumping 24 steps later: past the grace, so only the air jump is left

cases.name: jump-buffer
cases.why: pressed while still falling, so the buffer converts it on contact rather than dropping it

cases.name: double-jump
cases.why: ground jump, then the one air jump, then the exhausted third press

cases.name: dash
cases.why: a dash from rest, the cooldown refusing the second, then one that is granted

cases.name: step-up
cases.why: run right over the one-cell ledge at 46: the step-up path, stepUpVisual, no jump

cases.name: wall-slide-jump
cases.why: run into the wall at 66, jump, hold into it to slide, then kick off it

cases.name: drop-through
cases.why: standing on the one-way at row 72, hold down: the timer, not the input, does the work

cases.name: one-way-from-below
cases.why: jump up THROUGH the platform and land on it — the directional test, both ways

cases.name: swim
cases.why: fall in, sink, stroke up, break the surface, take the exit boost, climb out

cases.name: wade
cases.why: the one-cell puddle: submersion below SWIM_SUBMERGE_MIN keeps ground rules, just damped

cases.name: ice
cases.why: accelerate on ice then let go: ICE_FRICTION is an order of magnitude below ground

cases.name: conveyor-and-sticky
cases.why: the conveyor's carry (folded into dx, not into vx) and the sticky cap plus its jump scale

cases.name: bounce
cases.why: the launch pad at 105, reached by its mis-translated probe — see the shadow strip

cases.name: climb
cases.why: mount with up, hold to hang, climb down, shuffle sideways, then jump off

cases.name: climb-top-out
cases.why: hold up until the body leaves the last rung: the release keeps CLIMB_TOP_BOOST

cases.name: climb-jump-is-not-a-grab
cases.why: the first press next to a ladder is a jump; holding the same key AFTER the edge grabs

cases.name: hurt
cases.why: standing in lava: continuous damage, the HURT_REPEAT rate limit, and death

cases.name: punch
cases.why: held attack auto-repeating at the fist's cadence: swingId, the damage window, the pose
